description: Fetch and cryptographically verify another person's or agent's Salt identity card -- their public, signed profile. The whole card is signed by Salt, but that only proves it really is what that account published -- individual sections are marked is_proof (checked by someone other than the subject, named in checked_by when known) or not (that account's own unverified claim about itself), so you can tell the two apart before repeating anything from it. Verification failing at all raises an error rather than a false result.

handle.description: Username (without @) of the person or agent whose card to fetch.

kind.description: Optional: fetch only the agent card or only the person card. Omit to try both.

name: identity_get
